assertions.claim: The disposition reason "successor recital only; body and maps unheld (register)" rests expressly on the absence of a held act, contrary to corrected decision-reachability; a public competent-authority act is a holdable fact even when it has not yet been loaded.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Replace the absence-of-held-source reason with the actual expression-level disposition: the quoted successor recital identifies an act and adoption date but states no clock or numeric geometry; retain the missing body and maps only as an unresolved evidence-acquisition requirement.
assertions.falsifier: The builder identifies a permitted vested-elsewhere, fact-not-holdable, or producer-interval-closed ground that applies independently of the fact that DDS 148's body and maps are currently unheld.

checked_sound: Exhaustively reviewed all 151 distinct non-null dispositions[].why values in the 586-disposition current canonical. No reason used absence-of-practice, never-applied, historical-relevance, or no-case language; the DDS 148 "body and maps unheld" reason is the one surviving held-instance exclusion reported above.

Re-ran the uncovered-set comparison across all 523 unique Stage A rows and the 362 population members. The operative temporal rows outside the population remain the expressly held seam 4 notice, election, execution and enforcement chain plus IT-DM-169819-2022:Art.7(11):cessation-notice:v1, whose six-month duty belongs to a national reference laboratory toward the Central Plant Health Service and INRPP.

Verified all 15 closed-interval disposition instances across the eight pre-L.R. 45 producer rows. Every row is SUPERSEDED with effective_to_exclusive 2021-12-18; no current producer is excluded on that ground.

Verified B-CLK-EU-625-39-audit-recurrence and B-CLK-EU-625-39-audit-on-necessity against the complete Article 39 source quote. The two independently variable triggers are separately represented, and both applies_when fields accurately preserve the accreditation-assessment redundancy exception without narrowing it further.

Verified that the new Article 39 necessity trigger is holdable as the competent authority's own determination in OPERATOR_RECORD and remains within the regional official-laboratory designation and audit chain established by D.lgs. 19/2021 Article 14(1).

Verified pre-M5 and post-M5 Article 5(1)(c) separately: both versions retain the first-year period, 2.5 km survey-zone floor and 400 m higher-risk band, while only v2 carries the 90 percent confidence and 1 percent design-prevalence parameter.

Verified containment independently from eradication: Article 4 retains separate 2.5 km eradication and 5 km containment buffer floors; Article 15 retains the pre-M5 5 km and post-M5 2 km inward bands and the greater-than-5-km island exemption; DDS 31 and DDS 45 retain separate containment treatment-to-removal clocks and seasonal windows.

The present-row sample covered all 16 seam-kind combinations: seam 1 deadline, promptness_standard, recurrence and same_calendar_day; seam 2 deadline, eligibility_threshold, minimum_duration, ordering_constraint, promptness_standard and recurrence; seam 3 deadline, lookback_window, not_before, ordering_constraint, promptness_standard and recurrence. Each sampled source_phrase is verbatim in its Stage A source_quote, and no sampled resolving fact requires fabrication.
